author: bardic-inspiration
name: Whisperless Glaive
summary: A glaive that strikes from out of nowhere and leaves no echo.
description: The hush around it is deeper than the quiet in a library. Bodyguards of the old courts carried them in a thousand private rooms.

stats.effect: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature that cannot see you with it, the target takes an extra 2d6 Psychic damage.
